verdicts.verify_by: Read $(go list -m -f '{{.Dir}}' golang.org/x/sync)/singleflight/singleflight.go:160-170; a package-store test calling cached(ctx, newResponseCache(), "k", func(context.Context) (int, error) { panic("x") }) under a deferred recover exits the test binary with `panic: x` and a goroutine dump instead of recovering.
verdicts.tldr: A panic in any store load takes down the whole gnoweb process instead of failing one request
verdicts.details: cached always goes through group.DoChan, so the calling request is always a channel waiter, and singleflight v0.21.0 re-raises a load panic with `go panic(e)` whenever len(c.chans) > 0, on a fresh goroutine no recover reaches. Every realm page goes down with it, where net/http's per-connection recover would have lost one request. No input reaching a panic in decode, sanitize or the visuals was found, so the risk is latent. Fix: recover inside the DoChan closure and return the panic as an error, which the cache then stores like any failure.

Test not run (read-only judge).

verdicts.verify_by: gno test: Claim a /p/ path, 3 matured named stars, 3 Unstar; expect the package absent from api/v1/build, observe it present with stars 0
verdicts.tldr: A claimed listing stays confirmed on the shelves after the stars that confirmed it are withdrawn
verdicts.details: addStar calls l.confirm once rankedCount reaches confirmStars, and confirm only ever sets Confirmed true. removeStar removes the ranked entry and never re-checks, and nothing in the realm sets Confirmed back to false. So three matured named accounts can confirm an unverified claim and then unstar, and it keeps its exposure while showing 0 stars. Keeping the stars would confirm it just as well, so unstarring only hides who backed it. The cost is the T11 promise that a claim alone buys no exposure. Fix: drop Confirmed in removeStar when a claimed, not self-listed, listing falls below confirmStars, or state in the Confirmed comment that confirmation is permanent.
verdicts.evidence: Read: listing.gno:466-467 `if n >= confirmStars { l.confirm(s.Height) }`; listing.gno:259-265 confirm returns early if Confirmed, else sets it; listing.gno:479-489 removeStar has no Confirmed handling; grep 'Confirmed = false' over the realm: no hits. Build listing at 0 stars not run.

verdicts.tldr: Right after an app joins, a category's Next link can open a Not found page for up to 30 seconds
verdicts.details: servePage decides whether a page exists from pageParam with the count in the cached home response, but draws Next from res.Pages of the separately cached page response. paged only refuses res.Pages < page, so a fresh page 1 that reports more pages than the stale home count allows produces a Next link to a 404. Both entries live 30 s, so it clears on its own. Fix: cap Next at the page count pageParam derives, or take pages from the larger of the two.

Not run.
